title: Private endpoint affinity caused selection of incompatible quantized variant for tenant requests
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Summary:
A high-traffic enterprise customer on a Private deployment reported that a subset of their inference requests were returning semantically different outputs and higher error rates starting 2026-02-18. The investigation shows requests were being routed to a quantized model variant that is incompatible with the customer's tokenization/IO expectations and the Dedicated GPU architecture they reserved. This caused incorrect tokenization and occasional OOMs on the Dedicated pool, leading to user-facing errors and elevated latency.

Why this is urgent:
- Customer-facing quality regressions and errors for a Tier-1 customer.
- Dedicated capacity experienced OOM churn and increased tail latency while autoscale tried to compensate.
- The routing fault was deterministic for a class of requests (private endpoint + geo affinity) and not caught by standard unit tests.

High level impact observed:
- 12% increase in 5xxs for the tenant's production route between 2026-02-18 and 2026-02-20.
- 35% of failed requests attributable to model mismatch tokenization errors.
- Customer experienced degraded end-user UX and opened an escalation with CSM.
reproduction_steps: 1) Tenant has Private deployment with endpoint affinitized to eu-west-1 and a Dedicated GPU pool pinned to nvidia-a100-80gb.
2) Tenant pins model alias `prod-text-v1` which maps to model variants: prod-text-v1 (float16) and prod-text-v1-q4 (4-bit quantized) for cost fallback.
3) Smart routing policy includes two rules: prefer private endpoint affinity, then region proximity, then cost-tier fallback.

4) Under certain policy evaluation ordering and TTL cache state, the router selected the quantized variant hosted in eu-west-1 which uses a different tokenizer glue and runtime semantics incompatible with the customer's pinned float16 variant.
5) Observe tokenization mismatches in logs and increased OOMs on Dedicated hosts when the runtime attempted to run the quantized kernel on incompatible hardware path.
mitigation: Hotfix 2026-02-21: Added a temporary routing override that excludes quantized variants for tenants with Private/Dedicated reservations until compatibility check passes.
Scaled up Dedicated pool ephemeral capacity to absorb OOM churn and reduce request failures while rollback was applied.
Customer communication: emailed CSM with incident summary and immediate mitigation steps; customer accepted workaround pending full fix.
root_cause: A race in the policy evaluation path combined with an incomplete variant-compatibility map. The router's policy engine evaluated 'private endpoint affinity' before the new 'variant compatibility' constraint leading to selection of cheaper quantized variants hosted in the preferred region. Additionally, the compatibility cache had stale TTLs and did not include information that prod-text-v1-q4 requires a different tokenizer binary and a hardware opcode path incompatible with the dedicated pool's driver version. The result: quantized variant chosen for a tenant that expected float16 behavior, causing semantic regressions and OOMs.
fix_plan: 1) Short term (hotfix) - ensure policy engine enforces 'variant_compatibility' constraint before applying endpoint affinity (done 2026-02-21).
2) Medium term - augment the compatibility map: bake tokenizer/runtime semantics metadata into model catalog and add a compatibility check at routing time (ETA 2026-03-08).
3) Medium term - remove reliance on TTL-only cache: add event-driven invalidation when model artifacts or driver compatibilities change (ETA 2026-03-12).
4) Long term - add end-to-end integration tests in CI that simulate Private+Dedicates+variant falls to detect tokenization/drift mismatches (ETA 2026-Q2).
5) Postmortem and customer remediation plan: provide customer with a compatibility audit and assistance to pin safe variants, and regression test their critical prompts.
comments: 2026-02-20 - Aisha Patel: Initial triage. Reproduced on staging with synthetic requests. Observed tokenization mismatch log entries: "unknown_token_sequence". Escalating to routing and runtime owners.

2026-02-21 - Diego Morales: Hotfix deployed to production; routing override placed to exclude quantized variants for Private/Dedicated tenants. Immediate 5xx rate returned to near baseline. Scheduling compatibility map work.
2026-02-24 - Clara Vu (RELIABILITY): Confirmed Dedicated pool OOMs subsided after hotfix; we should verify autoscaler doesn't oscillate when compatibility flags flip.

2026-02-28 - Diego Morales: PR #4823 opened for policy engine change. Needs review from @infra and @catalog teams. Also opened catalog PR to include tokenizer_id and required-driver-version in model metadata.

2026-03-03 - PM note (Marcus Lee): CSM updated customer with mitigation and timeline. Customer requested conservative default: never route to quantized fallback in Private deployments unless explicitly enabled.
2026-03-05 - QA (Sanjay Iyer): Added integration tests that replay the customer prompt set against variant fallback paths. Tests failing until catalog metadata PR is merged.
postmortem_todo: Publish incident postmortem with timeline and root cause analysis.
Add a guided runbook for CSMs to quickly apply routing overrides for Private tenants.
Create an automated alert when a tenant's 5xx rate spikes coincident with a variant selection change in routing logs.
